title: elymus longifolius
intro: Elymus longifolius, commonly known as Wild Rye, is a perennial grass species native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Elymus longifolius include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help soothe coughs and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
